geographic_scope: Same region-v1 rectangular mask [-11,46]x[21,58]; policy scope and prior derivation prose are aliases of this bound geographic domain, not assertions of exhaustive sampling.
classification: Own actual renderer architecture, no original-game parity. Offline data-generalization products and actual render quadtree LOD are distinct address/level spaces.

overview.usage: Produced2048x1536 height+4096x3072water offline asset, not bound as regular renderer input.

canonical.usage: 3420x2220 loaded/verified at initialization; overwritten by native detail before scene creation. Integrity-failure fallback does not constitute an accepted normal render run.

detail.usage: Native13680x8880 height, fixed modelscale.001, renderRG8 + common SDF at every zoom; quadtree patch tessellation/morph changes, geographic data level does not.

actual_render_lod_contract: All actually observed quadtree levels and all valid zoom states retain screen<=2px and transition<=1px budgets; do not relabel or triple-copy actual detail observations into unrendered offline representations.
scope_alias: Prior entire region-v1; explicitly sampled sourcegeometry, not global proven bound -> entire project rectangular mask. Same regionhash, coordinate domain, raw samples and sampling-plan hash; sampling limitations retained verbatim.
temporal_limit: This application definition is fixed before any further final run; descriptive interpretation of earlier native-detail-only runs is identified by their actual hashes. It introduces no new pass threshold and cannot bless a changed renderer without its own matching evidence.
validator_limitation: Kit1ops-v5 derivation checker demands all6metrics for every offline level and has no explicit NA representation. Four unrendered-level runtime combinations remain a documented tool-contract gap, not invented measurements.
